issue.title: Fix max-int limit for number of points reduced in geo_centroid

labels.name: :Analytics/Geo
labels.description: Indexing, search aggregations of geo points and shapes

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
A bug in InternalGeoCentroid#reduce existed that summed up
the aggregation's long-valued counts into a local integer variable.
Since it is definitely possible to reduce more than Integer.MAX points,
this change simply updates that variable to be a long-valued number.

Closes #55992.

Any chance to have this fix applied to ES 6.x.x series?
Thanks.
Regards,
Angelo
